newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - University of South Carolina.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - University of South Carolina.

text.p: Sealed bids for the purchase of $4,500,000 Revenue Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds'') of the University of South Carolina (they''), will be rec
Office of the State Treasurer, in Room 121 of the Wade Hampton Office Building, Capitol Complex, Columbia, South Carolina, until 11:00 a.m., E.D.T., on

at which time and place bids will be opened for the purchase at a price of not less than 99% of the aggregate principal amount of the Bonds and accrued interest of the Bonds, dated April 1, 1997 maturing on June 1 of each year as follows:

Interest on the Bonds will be payable semiannually on June 1 and December 1 of each year, commencing December 1, 1997. Proponents for the Bonds have the option of specifying that the principal amount of the Bonds in any two or more consecutive years beginning not earlier than 2007, as given in the above Maturity Schedule, may, in lieu of maturing in each such years, be considered to comprise one or two maturities of Term Bonds scheduled to mature in the latest of such years and be subject to mandatory redemption by lot at par in the manner described in the Preliminary Official Statement for the Bonds. Proponents may specify one or two, but not more than two of such Term Bonds. The Bonds are subject to redemption at the option of the University on the terms and conditions as set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder offering to purchase the Bonds at such rate or rates of interest as will produce the lowest true interest cost (TIC) in accordance with the terms set forth in the Official Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be issued by means of a book-entry-only system with The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York, which will act as security depository for the Bonds. The University will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of Haynsworth, Marion, McKay & Guerard, L.L.P., Columbia, South Carolina, on or about April 30, 1997.
Requests for copies of the Official Notice of Sale herein summarized, the Bid Form, and the Preliminary Official
Statement relating to the Bonds may be obtained from University's Financial Advisor, A.G. Edwards & Sons, 3399 Peachtree Road, N.E., Suite 1270, Atlanta, Georgia 30326, telephone (404) 237-3280.
John L. Finan, Vice President for Business and Finance
